summary: Iteration 52 — backend testing of jobs push/badge, challenge PUT non-destructive, dashboard safety-net auto-upgrade, and commission push. 8/8 pytest passed. Verified via backend.err.log that job create with active=true and toggle inactive→active fire push_to_activated with title '💼 Nouvelle offre d\'emploi disponible !' (log: 'push ...: no tokens registered — skipping' — expected since no push tokens registered in preview env, but push path IS executed). /api/jobs/unread-count and /api/jobs/mark-seen work correctly. /api/dashboard is idempotent and does not crash even when try_auto_upgrade cannot promote (try/except wraps the safety-net loop). Frontend BottomNav.tsx exposes data-testid='bottom-nav-emploi-badge' correctly and /(app)/emploi.tsx calls POST /jobs/mark-seen on mount (verified in source). CRITICAL BUG found in matrix.py:237 — commission push notification tag references commission_doc['id'] but the dict never sets an 'id' field, so the try/except silently swallows KeyError and the commission push NEVER fires.

critical.issue: commission_doc['id'] KeyError inside the try/except block — commission_doc never has an 'id' key (only user_id/from_user_id/level/kind/amount/upgrade_share/profit_share/created_at). Every commission push is silently dropped. Fix: either add doc['id'] = str(uuid.uuid4()) before insert_one, or change tag to f"commission-{user_id}-{level}-{int(datetime.now().timestamp())}".

action_items: Fix matrix.py:237 commission push tag KeyError — add 'id': str(uuid.uuid4()) to commission_doc OR change the tag expression. The bug is invisible (silent try/except) but breaks the required 'push after commission credit' feature.
critical_code_review_comments: matrix.py:237 → commission_doc['id'] KeyError silently swallowed (HIGH). Push never fires.
challenges.py PUT (L141) is truly non-destructive — updates only fields on the challenge document, never touches db.challenge_progress. Confirmed by static review + PUT smoke test.
jobs.py order of routes is correct — static /jobs/unread-count and /jobs/mark-seen declared before dynamic /jobs/{id}. Well-commented explanation present.
jobs.py POST /admin/jobs/{id}/toggle fires push only on transition inactive → active — correct per spec.
server.py:672 dashboard safety-net: for _ in range(12): try_auto_upgrade wrapped in try/except → never blocks the response even if the cascade raises. User doc refreshed after promotion.
matrix.py:244 auto_upgrade cascade also fires 'Félicitations Niveau supérieur' push per spec — but uses tag=f'levelup-{user_id}-{upgraded_to}' which is safe (no dict lookup).

success_rate.frontend: Not fully retested — source code review confirms BottomNav testID and emploi.tsx mark-seen wiring; admin session cannot render user BottomNav.

seed_data_creation: Two TEST_iter52_* jobs and one TEST_iter52_ch_* challenge, all deleted at end of each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Only bug is matrix.py:237 commission_doc['id'] KeyError (silently swallowed). Everything else in the review request is implemented correctly. Frontend BottomNav Emploi badge cannot be seen from admin login — need a non-admin activated user to visually verify.
rca of the issue: matrix.py line 213 inserts commission_doc into Mongo without setting an 'id' field. Line 237 references commission_doc['id'] to build the push tag. The whole push_to_user block (lines 227-240) is wrapped in try/except: pass, so the KeyError is silently caught and the push is never dispatched. Repro: activate a level-2 for a user whose sponsor is level>=2 — the sponsor receives the commission (verified in earlier iterations) but NO push notification is triggered. Mitigation: add 'id': str(uuid.uuid4()) inside commission_doc dict before insert_one, then commission_doc['id'] works.
